findings.note: 'generated' has three hi renderings: निर्मित (this key), बनाई गई (supplement.sound_fallback_label 'बनाई गई ध्वनि'), जनरेट किए गए (ui.library.origin.generated). निर्मित is the correct choice here: invariant in oblique case, so 'निर्मित वीडियो को चलाया नहीं जा सका' and nominative alt both hold, whereas बनाया गया would need बनाए गए before को. Defer: align sound_fallback_label to 'निर्मित ध्वनि' in a later pass; not gating.

निर्मित is tatsam and slightly formal against the hi guide's preference for everyday Hindi, but it is the established attributive in current usage (AI-निर्मित) and reads naturally as an alt/aria label; keep.
